basis: Destination XL’s fiscal Q1 2024 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its consolidated statements of operations report sales of 115489000 for the three months ended May 4, 2024, versus 125442000 for the three months ended April 29, 2023. Sales fell 7.93%, below the 119169900 threshold. The earlier disclosures provided annual sales guidance, comparable-sales figures, or operational updates without a numeric upper bound for the full quarter’s consolidated sales.

coverage.detail: November 17, 2023, fiscal Q3 2023 release. The $520 million to $530 million sales range covered fiscal 2023. The discussion of fiscal 2024 addressed investment plans without a Q1 sales forecast.
November 17 management call, checked via transcript. Management’s projected mid- to high-single-digit comparable-sales decline applied to Q4 of fiscal 2023.

January 8, 2024 holiday update. DXL reported $102.4 million of sales for nine weeks ended December 30, 2023, and narrowed fiscal 2023 sales guidance to $520 million to $525 million. Both periods preceded fiscal Q1 2024.

March 21, 2024, fiscal Q4 2023 release. The $500 million to $530 million sales outlook covered all 52 weeks of fiscal 2024. The expected mid- to high-single-digit decline applied to comparable sales across the first half.

March 21 management call, checked via transcript. The CEO reported comparable sales down roughly 11% through the first six weeks of fiscal 2024. The CFO gave annual total-sales guidance and half-year comparable-sales assumptions. Neither speaker set a ceiling for consolidated Q1 sales.
April 29 update announced a Nordstrom marketplace collaboration. It provided no quarterly sales estimate.
May 9 post-quarter notice scheduled the results for May 30 before market open and the call for 9:00 a.m. ET. It disclosed no preliminary sales figure.

May 13 announcement described a three-market advertising campaign. Searches for intervening preliminary results, guidance updates, investor presentations and public management remarks found no qualifying Q1 sales disclosure before May 30.

May 30 actuals. DXL reported a 7.9% decline in total sales and an 11.3% decline in comparable sales. It identified $1.8 million of increased non-comparable sales and a $3.0 million calendar shift from fiscal 2023’s extra week, explaining why the earlier comparable-sales trend could not establish reported revenue.

publication_date_evidence: DXL’s investor-relations release is timestamped May 30, 2024 at 7:00 AM EDT. Its May 30 Form 8-K independently confirms that the company issued the Q1 results release that day. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/813298/000095017024066252/dxlg-20240530.htm
